campaign: C8 -- Operator-Information Feasibility and Route Selection
purpose: select exactly ONE primary route for C9, by objective criteria fixed before selection

authoritative_open_set.note: reconstructed from per-cell verdicts; cell 305 is PASS and ADOPTED and is NOT open

compute_boundary.note: driving the frozen TC-T rule at a non-certified (A0,A1,A2) is a deterministic transform of committed evidence and is labelled COUNTERFACTUAL; it evaluates no kernel and certifies no operator

the_decision_equation.clause: Gamma_k = g_hi + rho * x_hi * M,  pass iff Gamma_k < 0
the_decision_equation.A_enters_only_through: M, via the TC-T whole-cell enclosure [lo,hi] of R''_m
the_decision_equation.A_supply: Lemma Dv': A0 = min(Abar, tau/D_lo); A1, A2 are eff times fixed multipliers, so all three are PROPORTIONAL to eff
the_decision_equation.admissibility_floor: Lemma SM(d): A0 is admissible iff A0 >= sup_{e in cell} E_a[tau]. A certified LOWER bound on E_a[tau] is therefore a FLOOR on any admissible A0.

route_definitions.R2: cell uniformization gap, Delta_cell = sup_{e in cell} Lambda(e) - Lambda(e_lo)
route_definitions.R3: E1 / operator certification -- a better certified UPPER bound on sup E_a[tau] and better D1,D2,D_lo,C_T, i.e. smaller (A0,A1,A2)
route_definitions.R4: order-3 surrogate information (discovered during C8; recorded because the frozen TC-T rule takes an order3 argument and committed evidence quantifies its effect)

leverage_test.definition: a route has LEVERAGE on closure iff perfect information within it can make Gamma_k < 0 for at least one currently open cell
leverage_test.rule: a route whose perfect-information oracle leaves every open cell with Gamma_k >= 0 has ZERO closure leverage and MUST NOT be selected as a closure route, however cheap it is
leverage_test.rationale: C8 exists to find what advances the tail, not what is convenient to compute

MATHEMATICALLY_REFUTED_requires: a proof that even perfect information inside the route leaves Gamma_k >= 0; a merely unavailable input is BLOCKED, never REFUTED

ordering: 1. If a cell is already passing under committed certified supplies, its blocker is ADOPTION, not information. Route = GOVERNANCE, and no new information may be requested for it.
2. Otherwise prefer a sound ZERO-NEW-REAL analytic route if it achieves a material fraction of the required improvement on at least one open cell.

3. Otherwise prefer ZERO-NEW-REAL operator certification (R3) if its perfect-information leverage is material AND the minimum useful improvement is realistic against historical certifier behaviour AND the exact producer/toolchain is known.
4. Do NOT recommend new-real while a materially competitive zero-new-real route remains untested.
5. Do NOT authorize the R-stage. Do NOT set guard ALLOW.
decision_rule.material_fraction_definition: closes at least one currently open cell outright, OR reduces the required improvement factor on some open cell by at least 25 percent
decision_rule.tie_break: smallest sufficient information requirement, measured as the required improvement factor on the single quantity that must change

forbidden_conclusions: that any cell is CLOSED or ADOPTED by C8
that a counterfactual value is certified evidence
that a route is REFUTED when it is merely BLOCKED
that C8 itself may execute any selected route

disclosure_of_non_blindness.statement: This gate is frozen BEFORE any C8 result artifact is committed, but AFTER exploratory computation. The campaign already knows the approximate leverage of each route. The gate does not claim blindness.
why_this_does_not_compromise_soundness: The leverage test and the refutation standard are structural, not numeric thresholds tuned to an answer: a route is refuted only by a perfect-information proof, and selected only by the fixed ordering above.
The one numeric threshold, `material_fraction_definition`, governs ROUTE PREFERENCE, not validity, and cannot make an unsound route appear sound.
Every Gamma used is reproduced from committed evidence and checked against all twenty committed (A, Gamma) supply tuples before any counterfactual is evaluated.
disclosure_of_non_blindness.precedent: C7 froze its gate after exploration and said so; concealing the order would be contradicted by the transcript.
